commentary: A sharp 350-point Nifty rally propelled by IT relief cannot mask underlying breadth weakness, where a breadth score of 37 signals a fragile, selective tape. In Stan Weinstein's framework, relief rallies on selective participation warrant strict capital preservation until broad-market thrusts confirm Stage 2 synchronicity. Under William O'Neil's market-direction rules, market health dictates position sizing: progressive exposure must be tightly throttled. While index giants lift headline numbers, high-probability swing setups remain restricted to institutional leaders flashing genuine EPS acceleration and tight volume contractions. Do not chase extended beta; demand strict pivot discipline and preserve liquidity.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Theory

21STCENMGM.technical: While price cleared a 20-session high on 3.89x volume and trades above its 21, 50, and 200 moving averages, the micro-cap liquidity profile and erratic base structure fail Minervini's strict Trend Template criteria for institutional sponsorship.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Severely fails CANSLIM criteria. Operating with negative trailing earnings, an erratic top line, and deep negative ROE (-57%), the financial investment outfit lacks true operating leverage, margin consistency, and institutional backing.
21STCENMGM.risk: Failure below the designated swing stop at 43.53 invalidates the breakout; cut losses instantly under Minervini rules.

ADVANCE.technical: Strong Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-session high on an impressive 11.4x volume expansion. Price holds firmly above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA with an RSI of 70 reflecting genuine upside demand without yet reaching extreme exhaustion.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Delivers explosive top-line growth of +96% and profit surge of +152% YoY with healthy ROCE (19.6%) and ROE (17.2%). However, expanding working capital days (70.9 days) and limited multi-quarter history require monitoring.
ADVANCE.risk: Breakdown below the 128.51 stop invalidates the pivot structure, demanding immediate capital exit.

AEGISLOG.technical: Classic O'Neil Stage 2 leader resetting via a double-bottom pattern. Price successfully retested and held its rising 21-day EMA near all-time highs before staging a bullish reclaim, preserving superior relative strength across all major moving averages.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals: EPS growth sequentially accelerated from +42% to +269% YoY alongside +37% revenue expansion. High ROCE (19.8%) and ROE (20.7%), expanding terminal infrastructure, and strong operating cash flows confirm prime institutional quality.
AEGISLOG.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 1,383.96 double-bottom swing pivot stop; adhere strictly to stop discipline.

AEROENTER.technical: Constructive double-bottom formation testing neckline resistance with price positioned above its 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. The 5.55x volume surge indicates accumulation, though overhead supply near the 160 multi-month high looms.
AEROENTER.fundamental: While headline EPS surged +849% and sales rose +135%, CANSLIM quality filters flash caution: earnings were heavily inflated by ₹144 Cr other income rather than operating expansion. Low core ROE (8.4%) limits institutional appeal.
AEROENTER.risk: Violation of the 146.68 swing trough violates the bottoming pattern; cut losses swiftly.

AEROFLEX.technical: Textbook Minervini Trend Template: price sits within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above rising short and long-term averages. Accumulation is confirmed by a 9.3x volume spike and an RSI of 63, indicating an imminent volatility contraction breakout.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Robust CANSLIM profile with Q1 FY27 EPS surging +158% YoY on +72% revenue growth. Virtually debt-free balance sheet, operating margins steady near 23-24%, and ROCE of 18.9% highlight genuine operational acceleration in high-barrier niche manufacturing.
AEROFLEX.risk: A break below 522.61 breaches the 50-SMA structural base, requiring immediate disciplined exit.

AETHER.technical: Clean double-bottom base with price consolidating above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. An RSI of 64 and positive MACD confirm healthy momentum as it approaches the 1,815 neckline pivot to launch a new advance.
AETHER.fundamental: Solid specialty chemicals innovator posting Q1 EPS growth of +33% YoY on +27% revenue growth. High operating margins (31.5%) and strong long-term client contracts support growth, though a rich valuation (P/E ~95x) demands flawless execution.
AETHER.risk: Close below 1,676.19 breaks the second swing low support, triggering an immediate stop-loss.
